Variant WLC.2CH.7.6.v001 is underdetermined with r00-base retained and compatible with the ASV; not an excluded-fallback case (rule 53).

review_notes: Variant WLC.2CH.7.6.v001 (covers s038) is underdetermined; r00-base retained and compatible with the ASV text.

variant_decisions.evidence: Ketiv מחצצרים and qere מַחְצְרִים are spelling variants of the same hiphil participle 'sounding trumpets'; ASV 'the priests sounded trumpets' renders either identically, no italic supply bears on it, and the verse's only note (alternative_rendering, 'for the song of Jehovah') concerns a different phrase and cannot decide a reading. Base qere fallback retained.

Hiphil צָלַח 'make successful' rendered 'he prosperously effected'; the whole phrase is the verb's one rendering. Headed on prosperously by rule 44's subtraction: dropping it leaves 'effected', any effecting, while dropping 'effected' keeps the lexeme, exactly as 'made heavy' heads on heavy. Heading on effected as the lexical verb is the competing reading.

review_notes: Corrected the head of the הִצְלִיחַ unit from effected to prosperously: rule 44 heads a verb rendered by light verb plus complement on the word whose loss loses the lexeme, and 'prosperously' is what carries צָלַח.
